lesson_intro: Today we master 'Calculation Speed'. Simplification in SSC is not just about BODMAS; it's about seeing shortcuts in powers and roots. Toppers don't calculate (√3 + √2)²; they know the algebraic identity. Today we cover the Laws of Indices (powers) and the properties of Surds (roots). If you can manipulate powers of 2, 3, and 5 quickly, you win half the battle in the Math section. We also learn 'Rationalization'—the trick to getting rid of roots in the denominator.
